tool_args.rationale: A saturating hydraulic response with gradient attenuation and a negative additive square-root branch reproduces all seven paid observations to rounding precision (training RMSE about 1.5e-8). The model fits all four coefficients numerically and is ready for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Hydraulic model constrained to the recalled source range for rho
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The wide-gradient observations support rho near 0.894 when the additive branch is included, outside the recalled range of 0.69–0.72.

considered_alternatives.option: Hill saturation with multiplicative gradient attenuation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It approximates all seven observations but leaves residuals on the order of 0.003 RMSE, whereas the hydraulic model with a square-root branch fits to rounding precision.
The two wide-gradient observations already distinguish the attenuation and branch terms well enough to proceed directly to fresh confirmation.
